title: Bundles of Probability Schemes
summary: We study finite probability through a category whose objects are finite probability schemes and whose morphisms are probability-preserving maps, called bundles. A bundle simultaneously records a quotient of a sample space, the corresponding algebra of random variables, and the conditional schemes on its fibers. The pullback, transfer, and fiberwise averaging maps associated with a bundle give a functorial construction of conditional expectation and its projection properties.
